sources.label: AI was used in the making of these patches.
sources.author: byehi98
patch_list: Every in-app purchase completes instantly — coin packs, bundles and the no-ads offer — with no Google Play payment sheet.
Every watch-ad offer grants its reward instantly with no video.
All ads are permanently removed — banners, interstitials and app-open ads never load, and the store treats the no-ads product as owned.
